title: bromus arvensis subsp. parviflorus
intro: Bromus arvensis subsp. parviflorus, commonly known as Small-flowered Brome, is a subspecies of grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Small-flowered Brome include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
